WOG.title: Way Of Glory
WOG.observed: Dense but clearly separated rails, restrained thin borders, readable service labels, localized glossy button reflection, photo faces above lower captions and visible button hover feedback.
WOG.scope: Finish reference only. Its white rails, navy/gold graphics,3-column cards, values and1px hover movement are not SIRIUS requirements. No backend/source authenticity inference.

S02_plan.flow: SIRIUS preview loads -> inspect full-width rows in3 sections -> compare shared headers/columns for2-way,3-way and long names -> collapse/expand a league and add6 matches -> verify counts, stable mapping and preserved selection.
checks: One full-width row per fixture; no3-column card grid or nested heavy boxes.
Time/status, stacked teams/scores, result, handicap, U/O and extra cells align with shared header starts across leagues.
Long names stay within the team column with full-name tooltip; scores share team baselines.
League headers and shared market headers identify groups; visible versus full counts are clear.
Initial6 each and additional6 operate on match count before grouping; collapse does not inflate the count.
2-way does not invent a draw; handicap sign/home-away and U/O direction/line/price retain original market/outcome IDs.
No fabricated extra-market counts; no click surface on informational score/market labels.
S02_plan.verdictBoundary: Short structural feedback only; unfinished skin is not judged as the complete design.

fullAuditRequirements: Fresh SIRIUS full audit; MERCURY PASS not inherited.
Actual1920 and2560 pixels/viewport/DPR plus fixed1920 shell and3 independent scroll columns.
All8 sport PNGs and provided brand originals, real font glyphs, palettes, both banners and all modal states.
Evidence before/after corrections tied to frozen source/version; same-input passed checks may be reused within SIRIUS with mapping.

acceptedScope: NHL/league presentation and current team names remain accepted; only actual regressions can become findings.
No mobile redesign, extra game/media/transaction backend, new image generation or external-brand replication.
Start values are implementation defaults, not independent proof or immutable pixel targets.
